ModMetaData.name: UESDdebuger - UnityExplorer + SDB Debug
ModMetaData.author: UESDdebuger
ModMetaData.description: Debug toolchain mod for RimWorld: in-game UnityExplorer (UE 4.9.0, official binary unmodified, press F7 to show/hide UI) + SDB code-level debugger (McpRimDebug), used for RimWorld game debugging. 调试用模组：游戏内 UnityExplorer（UE 4.9.0，官方二进制零修改，按 F7 显示/隐藏界面） + SDB 代码级调试器（McpRimDebug），用于 RimWorld 游戏调试。 Portions of the materials used to create this content/mod are trademarks and/or copyrighted works of Ludeon Studios Inc.
